top_choice_rationale: P001 credits the original experiment and the people who did it: Katori's magic-wavelength proposal and first strontium lattice clock, and Ye's development of the scheme to about 1e-18. It is a distinct physical idea from the 2005 comb and 2012 ion-control prizes, independently reproduced in several laboratories, and a two-name allocation with an invention-and-development citation is defensible against the 2003-2006 primary record. P002 is a genuine discovery with a clear prediction-then-observation chain, but it is closer to the 2016 topological prize and the three-name credit is contestable (Hasan, Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang). I prefer P002 to no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile for P001 or P002; my only profile conflict (aberration-corrected TEM, B027) is not on the slate
